description: Inject external webpage, news article, or YouTube URLs into WordFlux Content Automation / Auto-Scheduler for background scraping, carousel generation, and scheduling. Do NOT use this to edit existing drafts.

autoSchedule.description: If true (default), auto-generates and schedules posts; if false, saves to Content Automation (internal name: Radar) for review first

contentText.description: Optional extracted body text or transcript

convertYoutubeVideo.description: If true (default), extracts YouTube video transcript

customInstructions.description: Optional custom repurposing instructions for this URL

platforms.description: Optional target platforms override for this URL

url.description: Webpage, news article, blog post, or YouTube URL

name: wordflux_inject_urls_to_autoscheduler
